name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit. Response(at_exit, holding_box) makes the box be held when the exit is reached, which is how 'carry c to a' is mapped. Response(box_fell, holding_box) is the 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' rule. All three are hard, the propositions are in the right order, all are declared and grounded in the environment, and none is redundant. No siren or extra requirement is added.

texts: Reach the exit: the agent must stand on the exit cell at some step.
Carry the box to the exit: every time the agent stands on the exit, it must be holding the box on that step.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again, so that it holds the box on that step or later.
